test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Simple interest on a certain sum is frac{{54}}{{75}} of the sum. What is the rate of interest per annum if the value of the rate of interest per annum is half the time period (in years) of investment?
solution:
Given: 

Simple Interest (SI) = 54/75 × Principle

Formula used: 

SI = (P × R × T)/100 

Calculation: 

According to the question, 

Let the Time is T.

So, according to the question T = 2R

Simple Interest (SI) = 54/75 × Principle

⇒ 54/75 × P = (P × R × 2R)/100 

⇒ R² = 36

⇒ R = 6%

∴ The rating percentage of the interest will be 6%.
